verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Unreal Editor exists and supports Blueprint visual scripting for designers (unreal-docs-1), Python/C++ scripting integrated into the Editor (unreal-docs-2, unreal-docs-4, unreal-docs-29), and plugins that extend Editor capabilities (unreal-docs-5, unreal-docs-13), implying a full editor environment. However, the pack never directly documents the core viewport, inspector, or prefab/scene-composition workflows that define level-building UX, relying instead on adjacent scripting/automation docs, and community notes (unreal-comm-15, unreal-comm-7) suggest Blueprints alone are limited for complex work, pushing users toward C++. Missing for 10: direct documentation of viewport navigation, inspector/details panel, level/scene composition and prefab (Blueprint actor) workflows, plus independent hands-on corroboration of the visual editor as primary build method.
